statements.t: Increasing the Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) will result in increasing credit creation.

statements.fact: CRR applies to the whole NDTL; ICRR applies to incremental NDTL (e.g. Aug 2023), not to lending.

statements.t: 'Tenor Premium' is an important component in the calculation of the Marginal Cost of Funds based Lending Rate (MCLR).

statements.d: long-term ... lower than the Bank Rate
statements.fact: MSF is an overnight window at repo + 25 bp, aligned with the Bank Rate.
